profile.reading:
DartPoints operates a data center at 1000 Catawba Street, Suite 180, in Columbia, South Carolina, located within the South Carolina Research Authority Innovation Center, under the company code CAE01 referencing the Columbia airport designation. This facility traces its origin to Immedion, a Greenville, South Carolina-headquartered colocation provider founded in 2007 that operated eight data centers across seven markets, before DartPoints announced its acquisition of the company on March 16, 2021, in a deal that more than doubled DartPoints' edge interconnection footprint. DartPoints' individual facility page for this site lists 15,000 total square feet of raised floor with an 8,200-square-foot data hall, drawing 2 megawatts of utility power against a 110-kilowatt critical IT load, cooled by 120 tons of N+1 redundant capacity. Notably, DartPoints' own South Carolina market-overview page states different figures for this same facility, 2.5 megawatts of utility power and a 0.905-megawatt critical IT load, a discrepancy between DartPoints' own pages that is documented here honestly rather than silently resolved by picking one figure over the other. That overview page also claims SOC 2 Type II and Uptime Institute Tier III Design certification for this site, but the individual facility page uses only general "AICPA SOC-compliant" language without naming a specific SOC 2 Type II report or Tier rating, so those specific certification claims are not asserted here as independently confirmed. As is standard industry practice, tenant identities are not publicly disclosed.

DartPoints markets itself company-wide as serving more than 900 enterprise customers, including universities, hospital systems, and Fortune 500 companies, and has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing private US companies in multiple recent years.

reading.body:
DartPoints Columbia operates 2 MW of IT capacity in South Carolina's only downtown data center, accounting for 30 percent of the state's published 6.6 MW total across four named facilities.

The facility sits within the SCRA Innovation Center in downtown Columbia. DartPoints, a regional operator focused on Tier 2 and Tier 3 markets outside major metros, acquired majority control in April 2025 through NOVA Infrastructure and Orion Infrastructure Capital, which committed more than 250 million dollars in combined growth capital. The operator emphasizes AI-ready infrastructure and SOC 2 Type II compliance. At assumed 40 kW per rack, the 2 MW translates to roughly 50 racks.

South Carolina's published capacity of 6.6 MW places it far below states hosting concentrated AI workloads. The state's grid capacity and the specific facility's power provisioning are not published, making it impossible to assess whether this site represents available or constrained power resources for compute scaling. DartPoints operates 11 facilities across 10 markets, but most regional data centers in this portfolio lack published capacity figures, limiting visibility into the operator's total contribution to regional compute infrastructure.
